drivers: Simple two-step chain: 2% of 300 = 6 meetings, 1/4 of 6 = 1.5 sales, times 15000
Fractional result (1.5 sales) may confuse some solvers who round to 1 or 2 sales (distractors 15000-adjacent not present, but 11250 and 45000 catch partial errors)
Low working-memory load and generous 120s limit; paper allowed
Percent-of-number computation is familiar everyday arithmetic
